sourceTitle: The Doubts of Infidels Or, Queries Relative to Scriptural Inconsistencies & Contradictions
description: "The Doubts of Infidels" by William Nicholson is a philosophical inquiry written in the early 19th century, which critically examines inconsistencies and contradictions in the Scriptures. The book, presented as a series of questions aimed at religious authorities, highlights troubling aspects of biblical narratives and the moral implications derived from them.
